g001.text: Low urgency. Rest at home and drink fluids. Monitor symptoms.

g002.text: High urgency. Seek urgent care now. Difficulty breathing needs immediate help.

g003.text: Medium urgency. Visit a clinic within 24 hours for assessment.

g004.text: Low urgency. Rest and fluids are appropriate. Self-care and monitoring are enough.

g005.text: High urgency. Seek emergency services. Do not delay care at home.
